name: account-switcher-claude-code
description: Switch between multiple Claude Code accounts in one click. See every account's 5-hour and weekly usage limits, auto-continue chats when a limit hits, and pin folders or chats to their own Claude account. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic.

Claude Accounts: Pin Chat to Account…

enumDescriptions: Open Accounts opens the page as an editor tab, where files open.
Open Accounts shows the page in its sidebar view.
claudeswitcher.accountsView.description: Where "Open Accounts" shows the Claude Accounts page. Both are always available: the sidebar view from its activity-bar icon, the tab from the command.

claudeswitcher.trackAllAccounts.description: Show every saved account's 5-hour and weekly usage, renewing saved logins in the background so the figures stay live. Turn off to stop all background renewals and usage checks.

claudeswitcher.confirmOrganizationSwitch.description: Ask before a switch you make moves to an account in another organization. Chats that continue there lose Claude's earlier thinking, so their next replies may be slower and use more tokens. Automatic switches never ask.

claudeswitcher.cards.tint.description: Tint each account's card on the Accounts page with the account's colour.

claudeswitcher.cards.context.description: Show how full each account's latest chat is, as a faint grid on its card.

claudeswitcher.cards.toggles.description: Show the Remote Control and Artifacts switches on each card.

claudeswitcher.statusBar.usage.description: Show the active account's usage figures in the status bar.

claudeswitcher.statusBar.loginDays.description: Show how many days the active account's main and pinning logins have left, after the usage figures in the status bar, such as 16d and 23d.

claudeswitcher.checkForUpdates.description: Once a day, ask GitHub whether a newer Switcher has been released, and say so on the Accounts page and in the status bar. It sends nothing about you or your accounts; like any website you visit, GitHub sees your internet address and the time. This setting belongs to each editor: off here stops this editor asking and showing, while another editor on the same PC with it on still asks once a day.

claudeswitcher.usageIcon.description: Codicon id for the usage meter, without the $() wrapper. Account icons are set on the Claude Accounts page.

claudeswitcher.root.description: Where the switcher keeps its saved accounts. Defaults to ~/.claude-switcher
